int KtECourseGuardItem::GetMachineId() const // 1
{
    int value(0);
    ktcSpecRW.GetValue("MachineId", value);
    return value;
}
//-----------------------------------------------
HRESULT KtECourseGuardItem::GetGuardLength(double& value) const // 2
{
    return ktcSpecRW.GetListValue("GuardLength", value);
}
